title: Networked AR Renderer
purpose: Simulator-neutral networking requirements and test inputs
status: Provisional simulation allocations; retained project limits are identified separately.

units.time: microseconds unless a field ends in _ms or _s

scope.accounting_scope: aggregate outbound per client across all recipients; per-client scope and rolling window are profile assumptions

timing_allocations.copy_schedule: First eligible opportunity then next two opportunities; do not wait for ACK. Default sends all three for conservative load.
timing_allocations.boundary_rule: All limits are inclusive. Use exact rational periods or sufficient precision; never round deadlines down.

bandwidth.charge_instant: tx_start of each complete physical frame
bandwidth.debit_rule: Charge complete coded frame bits once per physical emission, even if dropped. Charge each sender or relay separately.
bandwidth.silent_guards: Consume airtime; do not count as transmitted bits.
bandwidth.admission: Check rolling ledger before transmission. Reserve costs for urgent repeats and ungateable hardware retries. A token bucket alone is insufficient.
bandwidth.borrowing: Unused capacity may be lent only when required control and pending urgent reservations remain feasible. The total ceiling is binding.

protocol.transport: Unreliable datagram abstraction for the initial simulator
protocol.alternative: Negotiated TAK Protocol only with AR extension round-trip preservation
protocol.xml_schema_and_type_catalog: Provide selected actual profile before encoded-wire qualification
protocol.georeference_rule: Provide a valid mission-to-WGS84 and UTC map. An isolated synthetic mission is allowed when explicitly labeled. Do not fabricate a production position or UTC.
protocol.receiver_rule: Authenticate, validate schema/epochs/owner and publish one authorized revision. Apply an event at most once.

transport_queue.use: Simulate bytes, service, queues, loss and contention; I and P are external allowances
transport_queue.phy_rate_status: Illustrative simulator input, not a selected or measured DDL PHY
transport_queue.D_computation: encode + MAC queue after encoding + serialization/FEC/guards as applicable + route delays + decode/publication; never add another fixed 20 ms
transport_queue.radio_medium: One shared half-duplex collision domain unless an explicitly declared independent-channel model is selected
transport_queue.reservation_rule: Every active source requires real non-overlapping service. Arbitration delay counts toward W or D according to timestamp boundary.

integrated_rf_display.use: Add actual video schedule, headset return, RF contention, rendering and scanout
integrated_rf_display.ddl_receive_constraint: Both local eye transmitters silent for DDL receive
integrated_rf_display.guard_pll_reacquisition_cost: Required explicit input; never assume the entire quiet interval is net capacity
hardware_not_established: R1 720p90 stereo input and scan timing

default_workload.required_recipients: All other currently configured participants at input onset; freeze that set for scoring.
default_workload.event: Create an identified marker with an unpredictable value; receiver visible result must carry the matching ID and value.
default_workload.input_pattern: Periodic with per-node seeded phase; no required inputs during warmup or drain.
default_workload.cost_fixture_note: All sizes are abstract complete-frame costs, not measured XML lengths. Control fixtures represent clock, membership and receipt traffic. In encoded mode replace them with actual messages and charge every real ACK; do not omit or double-count placeholders.
default_workload.fanout_cost_rule: Multiply addressed application copies by actual physical emissions. Replace one-to-many unicast with one emission only for explicitly supported common RF delivery.

sweeps.interpretation: Sweep points are experiments, not capacity promises. Vary one dimension first; combine passing cases and search around the boundary.

resource_defaults.status: Simulator defaults only; replace with measured capacities
resource_defaults.tombstone_policy: Retain through the complete test run; reconnect after retention loss requires an epoch/snapshot barrier.
resource_defaults.overflow: Log cause; do not increase capacity invisibly. Rejected required inputs count as failed obligations.
resource_defaults.late_event: May apply after deadline for convergence; the original deadline failure remains.
resource_defaults.fragmentation: Explicitly chunk oversized durable transfers and charge all chunks. Urgent events must fit the configured transport unit or fail that profile.

cases.name: Clean path
cases.expected: Zero response misses and no bandwidth or profile violations.

cases.name: One erased copy
cases.loss: Erase urgent copy index 0 for each selected event and recipient.
cases.expected: Next copy succeeds; upper response budget 83.222223 ms.

cases.name: Two erased copies
cases.expected: Copy index 2 succeeds; upper response budget 94.333334 ms.

cases.name: Independent loss
cases.loss: Independent Bernoulli decisions per transmission and recipient.
cases.expected: Report every miss. Do not condition the trace to remove long runs.

cases.name: Jitter and phase
cases.loss: No forced erasures; combine with Q1 and Q2 for bounded variants.
cases.expected: Log D as simulated; never clamp it to 20 ms to force a pass.

cases.name: Shared blockage
cases.loss: One loss mask affects all recipients and adjacent copies.
cases.expected: Only the bounded one/two-loss variants are deadline qualification cases.

cases.name: Severe loss and outage
cases.loss: Unbounded random loss or bidirectional outage.
cases.expected: Report deadline failures, recovery time and repair cost; retain local operation.

cases.name: Duplicate reorder and replay
cases.loss: Deliver duplicates, older revisions and delayed packets.
cases.expected: No duplicate side effects, unauthorized updates or state rollback.

cases.name: Overflow and simultaneous input
cases.loss: No injected loss; saturate queues and byte admission.
cases.expected: Bound all queues; every rejected or delayed required input remains a failure candidate.

cases.name: Partition and rejoin
cases.loss: Partition for 1000 ms; replay an old create after a newer delete.
cases.expected: No owner takeover or resurrection; log deadline failures and convergence time.

cases.name: Video and ranging coexistence
cases.loss: Use actual radio availability, guards and contention.
cases.expected: Inherited serial ranging study must be flagged infeasible; do not grant fictitious slots.

trace_contract.null_rule: Use null for unavailable times. For photon-evaluated runs, a missing correct photon result fails after its deadline. For publication-only runs, photons and full service acceptance are not assessed; missing or incorrect publication still fails the conditional networking check.
trace_contract.global_time: Use the simulator truth clock for scoring; local timestamps and clock mappings are additional modeled data.

scoring.response_pass: effect_correct and apply_count == 1 and latency_upper_us <= 100000 for every required input/recipient/eye/test-region obligation
scoring.service_pass: All response obligations pass and every node meets the rolling transmit ceiling, with authority and duplicate invariants intact.
scoring.profile_pass: Service pass plus all proposed stage allocations and bounded-loss assumptions satisfied.
scoring.network_only_estimate_us: (t_publish_us - t_ready_us) + 10000 + 30000 + 1000; do not add I again if the trace already starts at physical input.
scoring.network_only_label: Conditional networking pass under assumed I/P/U; local MTP, photons and hardware timing not assessed.
scoring.percentiles: Compute latency percentiles on delivered-correct samples and state that denominator. Also report the full obligation failure fraction; percentiles never replace the maximum requirement.
scoring.end_of_run: Stop generating inputs, drain for 1 s, and retain all obligations. Classify each failed obligation once; missing delivery remains missing even if a later session repairs it.
scoring.conditional_network_pass: For every required obligation, correct authenticated publication occurs no later than 59000 us after readiness, the byte ceiling and correctness invariants hold, and I/P/U remain declared assumptions. Leave unmodeled photon times null and label full optical service acceptance not_assessed.

requirements.name: Remote response
requirements.requirement: Every valid test input shall produce its defined correct visible result at every required recipient within 100 ms, including timing uncertainty.
requirements.evidence: Input-to-photon trace per input and recipient

requirements.name: Transmit ceiling
requirements.requirement: Each client shall charge at most 200000 transmitted bits in every rolling 1000 ms window, summed across recipients, retries and forwarded copies.

requirements.name: Application format
requirements.requirement: Every participant application exchange shall be a CoT event. XML 2.0 is the initial profile; any TAK binary form requires explicit negotiation and detail-preservation tests.

requirements.name: Serverless operation
requirements.requirement: No dedicated application server, cloud service or global simulation sequencer shall be required for ordinary owner-authored state.

requirements.name: Local operation
requirements.requirement: Both navigation estimators shall continue at 1000 Hz. Peer loss or backpressure shall not pace local estimation or the 90 Hz renderer.
requirements.evidence: Local task and render deadline logs

requirements.name: Display integration
requirements.requirement: Retain PCB 1 CM5, PCB 2 navigation, PCB 3 HDMI capture, ROG XREAL R1 and 1280 by 720 per eye at 90 Hz. Local physical motion-to-photon shall remain at most 20 ms.

requirements.name: Input processing
requirements.requirement: Input onset to an event ready for scheduling shall be at most 10 ms in this profile, including headset return transport when present.

requirements.name: Urgent service
requirements.requirement: A pending urgent event and its next two copies shall have eligible starts no more than 1000/90 ms apart, including first-slot wait, arbitration and byte admission.

requirements.name: Successful delivery
requirements.requirement: A successful attempt shall publish authenticated decoded data at the recipient within 20 ms of its encoding start.

requirements.name: Display allowance
requirements.requirement: Publication to the first correct visible effect in the specified eye and test region shall be at most 30 ms.

requirements.name: Timing uncertainty
requirements.requirement: Use at most 1 ms as a conservative added bound on input-to-photon timing uncertainty; do not add it twice.

requirements.name: Loss bursts
requirements.requirement: Qualify loss of the first one or two urgent copies, with the next copy delivered within NET-009 and all other allocations met.

requirements.name: Event retention
requirements.requirement: Retries shall preserve the event ID. Receivers shall apply each operation at most once. State coalescing shall not erase discrete events.

requirements.name: Authority
requirements.requirement: Only authorized owners and epochs may update an entity. A disconnect shall not transfer ownership. Preserve tombstones and observation provenance.

requirements.name: Bounded work
requirements.requirement: Declare byte and entry capacities for queues, histories, parser inputs and repair. Overflow shall be logged; rejected required inputs count as deadline failures.

requirements.name: Physical feasibility
requirements.requirement: All transmit and receive operations shall obey the modeled MAC, interference, half-duplex, video, ranging and guard constraints.

requirements.name: Complete denominator
requirements.requirement: Freeze required recipients at input onset. Keep every valid offered input in the result, including late, rejected, missing and outage-affected inputs.

requirements.name: Scaling
requirements.requirement: Report the passing participant and activity envelope. Test populations are sweep points, not a project participant-count cap.
